name: @magus/agents
description: The guard-hook templates a magus workspace installs into an agent host, kept beside the guide that documents them (docs/guides/integrations/agents.md). Ships NO runtime code: the shell templates are copied into a host's hook config and the OpenCode plugin is loaded from source by OpenCode's own Bun runtime. devDependencies are the lint and type-check gates only - @opencode-ai/plugin for the Plugin type and bun-types for Bun.spawn, neither of which is bundled anywhere. pnpm (pinned in mise.toml), NOT npm; .npmrc's minimum-release-age is the supply-chain guard.
